title: AcrossVAM2.0: Conflict-Aware Point Supervision for Parameter-Efficient Video Diffusion Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2610.14693v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Explicit point correspondence is attractive for adapting video generators: it describes how visible surfaces move, but can overwrite the appearance prior learned by a large pretrained model. We study this tension in a 5.01B-parameter text-to-video diffusion transformer. ACROSSVAM2.0 combines a confidence-weighted track-and-visibility head, zero-initialized residual feedback, and asymmetric PCGrad that removes only the auxiliary component opposing the primary flow-matching gradient on shared LoRA parameters. The design preserves the generator exactly at initialization and protects its primary update during adaptation. In a four-way ablation trained for 1,000 steps with three independent seeds, the full method lowers KLT forward-backward cycle error in all three seeds relative to a matched flow-only continuation (mean seed-level difference -0.00711, SD 0.00505), while robust sharpness remains positive in all three. translated_title: AcrossVAM2.0：面向参数高效视频扩散适配的冲突感知点监督
translated_abstract: 显式点对应对于适配视频生成器极具吸引力：它描述了可见表面如何运动，但可能会覆盖大型预训练模型所学到的外观先验。我们在一个 51 亿（5.01B）参数的文本到视频扩散 Transformer 中研究了这一矛盾。ACROSSVAM2.0 结合了置信度加权的跟踪与可见性预测头、零初始化的残差反馈，以及一种非对称 PCGrad 方法——该方法在共享 LoRA 参数上仅移除与主流匹配梯度相对抗的辅助梯度分量。这一设计在初始化时精确保持生成器不变，并在适配过程中保护其主更新方向。在采用三个独立随机种子、训练 1,000 步的四路消融实验中，完整方法在全部三个种子上均降低了 KLT 前后向循环误差（相对于匹配的仅流匹配延续训练，种子级平均差异为 -0.00711，标准差为 0.00505），同时鲁棒清晰度在所有三个种子上均保持正值。在一个扩展的 24 个提示的 ev……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ACROSSVAM2.0 通过置信度加权跟踪头、零初始化残差反馈和非对称 PCGrad，在共享 LoRA 参数上实现冲突感知的点监督，从而以参数高效的方式将显式点对应引入视频扩散模型适配，同时保护预训练模型的外观先验不被破坏。
en_tdlr: AcrossVAM2.0 enables conflict-aware point supervision for parameter-efficient adaptation of a 5B-parameter video diffusion transformer by combining a confidence-weighted track-and-visibility head, zero-initialized residual feedback, and asymmetric PCGrad on shared LoRA parameters, preserving the pretrained model's appearance prior during adaptation.
